name: tr-business-nace
title: NACE Rev. 2.1 economic activity codes of Türkiye
description: The NACE Rev. 2.1 six-digit national classification used in Türkiye (TÜİK Sınıflama Sunucusu surumId 1676, 2026): 23 sections, 87 divisions, 287 groups, 651 classes and 2,142 subclasses, with Turkish and English names and parent codes.

sources.title: TÜİK Sınıflama Sunucusu, NACE Rev.2.1-Altılı 2026 (surumId 1676): 3,190 hierarchy rows with codes, parents, levels and TR/EN names, retrieved 2026-11-16. Reuse with attribution (TÜİK Yasal Uyarı).

fields.name: code
fields.description: NACE code as published: a letter for a section, two digits for a division, then dotted forms for group (01.1), class (01.11) and subclass (01.11.07). Keep leading zeros.

fields.name: parent_code
fields.description: Code of the parent row. Empty for sections.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Hierarchy level: section, division, group, class or subclass.
